name: GAMMA-Ray Spectrum
status: The rules of the brief of 10 November 2026 (briefs/spectrum-0.1.md), implemented as written. A working name; the name is the operator’s to decide.
reading: A public card counts every documented answer: as shipped, available, or in a deployment. An available feature is marked as available.

dimensions.name: Autonomy
dimensions.question: What does the agent do on its own?

levels.name: Assists
levels.means: Answers, drafts, summarises; a person does each step

levels.name: Suggests
levels.means: Uses tools and data, proposes actions; a person approves each one

levels.name: Acts
levels.means: Completes routine tasks end to end in production; a person handles exceptions

levels.name: Orchestrates
levels.means: Runs multi-step workflows across systems or coordinates other agents; a person sets goals and reviews outcomes

levels.name: Open protocol
levels.means: A published agent interface with documented authorisation

levels.name: Stated
levels.means: Documents say how people approve, override or stop it

levels.name: Configurable
levels.means: Approval modes, permission scopes and roles are documented settings

levels.name: Observable
levels.means: Audit logs, a way to pause or stop, and monitoring are available

levels.name: Enforced
levels.means: Limits enforced outside the agent, described in public

levels.name: Disclosed
levels.means: Says it is AI and what it is for

levels.name: Documented
levels.means: Public documents on how it works, its data, its models and its limits

levels.name: Measured
levels.means: Publishes evaluations, and a way to report problems or read it by machine

levels.name: Verified
levels.means: An independent party has checked it

stages.name: Exploring
stages.reads: Agentic features are live and documented

stages.name: Building
stages.reads: Agents do real work, with controls taking shape

stages.name: Scaling
stages.reads: Agents act in production, connect openly, show their work

stages.name: Pioneering
stages.reads: Sets the bar others in the sector measure against

badges.name: Balanced
badges.rule: Control and Openness are each at least Autonomy minus one

badges.name: Shows its work
badges.rule: Openness is level 3 or higher, with published evaluations

badges.name: Verified
badges.rule: Openness reaches level 4 on an independent party’s evidence

badges.name: Rising
badges.rule: Moved up at least one level since the previous edition

badges.name: Claimed
badges.rule: The company reviewed the card and added evidence
